# Fetch note content for candidate note_id=2023 and identify recipe names
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
sn_pwd = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
access_token_sn = apis.simple_note.login(username='corwils@gmail.com', password=sn_pwd)['access_token']

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2023, access_token=access_token_sn)
print('note metadata:', {k: note.get(k) for k in ['note_id','title','tags','pinned','created_at','updated_at']})
print('note content:\n', note.get('content','')[:2000])

content = note.get('content','') or ''
# Try to extract recipe-like names: lines starting with '-' or numbering, or capitalized phrases.
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip()]

candidate_names=[]
for ln in lines:
    # bullet or numbered
    m = None
    import re
    m = re.match(r'^(?:[-*]|\d+[\.|\)]|\w+[\.|\)]?)\s*(.+)$', ln)
    if m:
        candidate_names.append(m.group(1).strip())
    else:
        # if line contains ':' take before ':' as name
        if ':' in ln and len(ln.split(':',1)[0].strip())>2 and len(ln.split(':',1)[0].strip())<60:
            candidate_names.append(ln.split(':',1)[0].strip())

# Deduplicate while preserving order
seen=set(); uniq=[]
for n in candidate_names:
    if n.lower() not in seen:
        seen.add(n.lower()); uniq.append(n)

print('Extracted candidate recipe names (first 30):', uniq[:30])

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
ingredients:
- 200g firm tofu, cubed
- 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, broccoli, carrots, snap peas, etc.), sliced
- 3 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce
- 1 tablespoon sesame oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon ginger, minced
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- Cooked rice, for serving
instructions:
- In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil. Marinate the tofu cubes in this mixture for about 15 minutes.
- Heat vegetable oil in a wok or skillet over high heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, and stir-fry for a minute.
- Add the mixed vegetables and stir-fry for a few minutes until they are tender yet crisp.
- Push the vegetables to the side of the wok and add the marinated tofu. Cook until the tofu is golden and heated through.
- Combine the tofu and vegetables, and stir in the remaining marinade.
- Serve the stir-fry over cooked rice.

- Arrange lemon slices on top of each fillet.

- Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve with your favorite sides.

import re

# Ensure we have access tokens
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
sn_pwd = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
phone_pwd = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]

sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='corwils@gmail.com', password=sn_pwd)['access_token']

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2023, access_token=sn_token)
content = note.get('content','') or ''
print('Note title:', note.get('title'))
print('Content length:', len(content))

# Parse recipe blocks: capture name and favorite flag
pattern = re.compile(r"name:\s*(.*?)\n.*?favorite:\s*(true|false)", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
matches = pattern.findall(content)
print('Found name/favorite pairs:', len(matches))

# Build list
recipes = []
for name, fav in matches:
    recipes.append({'name': name.strip(), 'favorite': fav.lower()=='true'})

# Print verification table
print('Recipes parsed (name | favorite):')
for r in recipes:
    print(r['name'], '|', r['favorite'])

favorite_recipes = [r for r in recipes if r['favorite']]
print('Favorite recipes count:', len(favorite_recipes))
print('Favorite recipes:', [r['name'] for r in favorite_recipes])
